title: Work Address official deployments
description: The signed allowlist of Work Address's own escrow and registry deployments: deployments/official.json, written by `pnpm run official:manifest` (scripts/official-manifest.ts) and checked by `verifyOfficialManifest` in packages/identity, by the marketplace API before it signs escrow terms, by the site before it asks a wallet to fund an escrow, and by `verify manifest` on the command line. `signature` is EIP-712 over OfficialDeployments(uint64 issuedAt, OfficialDeployment[] deployments) under the domain {name: 'WorkAddressOfficialDeployments', version: '1'}, by `publisher`. A reader checks it against the publisher address it already trusts, never the one written here. No field outside this schema is allowed: a verifier refuses what it cannot check.

publisher.description: The address whose EIP-712 signature this is.

issuedAt.description: Unix seconds when the publisher signed. Signed.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id of this deployment.

release.description: The contracts release it was built from, e.g. contracts-0.1.0.

originSigner.description: MarketplaceEscrow.originSigner: whose terms signatures the escrow accepts.

feeRecipient.description: MarketplaceEscrow.feeRecipient: a multisig on any public chain.

deployBlock.description: First block holding these contracts: where an indexer or a log scan starts.

escrowCodeHash.description: The deployment manifest's escrow runtimeCodeHash: keccak256 of its code with immutables zeroed.
